title: Velocity: soft, normal and loud
thisBuild: Steps have three strengths now. Tap a step to turn it on, tap again for loud (a ring), again for quiet (half filled), and once more to turn it off.
16 Levels: Edit, then a pad, then 16 Levels. That sound fills all 16 pads, softest on pad 1 and hardest on pad 16. Tap the yellow banner to get your pads back.
Hits you record keep how hard they were: soft ones land as quiet steps, the hardest as loud ones.
A MIDI keyboard's velocity now plays and records too, instead of every key hitting full.
watch: Program a hat with some quiet steps between loud ones: does it groove more?
16 Levels on a snare, then record a roll from pad 1 up to pad 16.
With a MIDI keyboard: do soft keys sound soft?
limits: Plain taps on the pads still play at normal strength; a phone screen cannot feel how hard you press.
16 Levels spreads loudness only for now; spreading filter, length or pitch across the pads is a later step.
